entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Bench: D.Ramesh
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No. 3449 of 2020
O R D E R:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR No.307/2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Chirala Town Police Station, Prakasam District, against the petitioners for the offence punishable under Sections 188 and 273 r/w.34 IPC,
Sections 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standard Act.

entities.text: Chirala Town Police Station, Prakasam District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State.
Learned counsel for the petitioners has placed reliance on the common orders dated 18.12.2019 passed in Crl.P.Nos.5421 of 2019 & Batch respectively by this Court.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that the FIR may be quashed against the petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor did not oppose the said submission.

Considering the submissions and in view of the fact this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the criminal petition is allowed and proceedings in FIR No.307/2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Chirala Town Police Station, Prakasam District, against the petitioners, are hereby quashed; consequently no further action is necessary in the facts of the case.

entities.text: Chirala Town Police Station, Prakasam District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.
